page.meta_title: Aixovall Residencial · Homes made for living
page.meta_desc: Aixovall Residencial. New-build homes in Sant Julià de Lòria, Andorra. Explore the floors, layouts and availability, and configure your apartment to your taste.
page.hero_alt: Render of the Aixovall Residencial façade with timber and glass balconies
page.hero_eyebrow: NEW BUILD · SANT JULIÀ DE LÒRIA
page.hero_text:
A new home. A new chapter.
Your place in Aixovall.
page.man_alt: Living room opening onto the terrace
page.man_eyebrow: WHAT MAKES A HOUSE YOUR HOME
page.man_text:
No unnecessary excess.
No compromise on what counts.
page.man_detail: A home should be well built, make good use of space, be comfortable and work well for many years. We invest in everything that truly improves your everyday life.
page.ben_title:
You don’t need a luxury house.
You need a home where you can live well.
page.b1_alt: Bedroom with a desk by the window
page.b1_p: Spaces to share the present and imagine everything still to come. Family life starts at home.
page.b2_p: Homes with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms, with layouts designed to adapt to you and yours.
page.b3_alt: Living-dining room opening to the outside
page.b3_t: Open the door to the outdoors
page.b3_p: Balconies, terraces and a garden, depending on the type. Find the outdoor space that suits you.
page.story_title:
Some homes you visit.
In others you can already
see yourself living.
page.story_p1: Unhurried breakfasts. Coming home after work. Cooking dinner for friends. Stepping onto the balcony and remembering why you chose to live in Andorra.
page.story_p2: Aixovall Residencial was designed with those moments in mind.
page.story_alt: Kitchen and dining area of the T4 home with access to the balcony
page.story_cap: Layouts that make sense. Spaces to share.

page.cs_lead: Configure your apartment before or after you buy it. The first configurator for new-build apartments!
page.cs_text: We want everything to be just the way you like it. Choose the flooring, kitchen and bathrooms, see the result instantly and take away a summary with the prices.

page.cs_s2: See the change instantly, on the render of your apartment
page.cs_s3: Download the summary with the extra costs, ready to attach to the building specifications

page.cs_after_alt: The same kitchen configured with oak fronts, white base units and a grey worktop
page.cs_slider: Move the slider to compare the included kitchen with the configured one

page.homes_text:
Every home has its own way of living.
Discover the one that suits you.

page.contact_eyebrow: THE FIRST STEP STARTS WITH A CONVERSATION
page.contact_title:
Shall we talk?
Let’s imagine your
new home.
page.contact_text: We help you choose your home, understand the plans and answer any questions about the development.
page.q_cta_text: Choose the finishes for your apartment and see the result before you sign.
page.pg_title:
Pay for your home
as it is built.
page.pg_lead: Reserve it with €10,000 and we hold it for one month. The down payment is only 10% and 40% is paid at the notary: the rest is paid as construction progresses, certified by an architect.
page.p_fin_bank: can offer you special terms for this development: 0% assessment fee, 0% arrangement fee and much more.
page.p_pay_res_s: We hold the apartment for one month · counts towards the 10% deposit
page.p_pay_arr_s: Up to 10%, minus the reservation already paid
page.p_pay_cert: When an architect certifies the stage
page.p_pay_not_s: On signing the deed, with the handover of the keys
page.p_cal_note: Indicative dates. The deposit (arras) contract will set out the developer’s commitments.
page.p_pay_note: The reservation is not an extra amount. IGI ({r}) is added to each payment. Due dates per contract and certified construction progress.
page.p_cal_warn: Indicative dates. The deposit (arras) contract will set out the developer’s commitments.
page.p_pay_keys_t: What you pay before getting the keys
page.p_pay_keys_p: And only a 10% down payment. The remaining 40% comes with the deed: your loan costs you less interest while the home is built.
